svg.text: The FPGA computer booting: firmware, upload, program, report
Real firmware (fpga/firmware/bios.s) and program (programs/01_hello.s) on the cycle-exact model; the serial output is what the board prints.

g.text: Power on: the PLL locks, reset is held, RESET_VECTOR = 0x0000
The core fetches the boot firmware at 0x0000: an I-cache miss, then a line from block
The firmware prints its banner: each character is a store to PUTCHAR (0x1000_0000)
devices : UART, LEDs, buttons, switches, 7-segment digits…
Your PC sends 'l', the address, the length, 64 program bytes and a checksum
devices : UART, LEDs, buttons, switches, 7-segment digits…
The firmware stores every byte at 0x2000..: write-through, straight into main memory
devices : UART, LEDs, buttons, switches, 7-segment digits…
'r': the firmware clears the registers and stores to BOOT; the system resets the core
devices : UART, LEDs, buttons, switches, 7-segment digits…
The program runs from 0x2000, exactly as in simulation, and prints through the same UART
devices : UART, LEDs, buttons, switches, 7-segment digits…
It writes TOHOST, the core halts; the firmware comes back and reports the cycle count
devices : UART, LEDs, buttons, switches, 7-segment digits…

svg.text: The same sequence runs in simulation for every program (make fpga-sim) and in the browser on the site.
